notes: Webcruiter (Talentech) candidate portal — one host-wide account serves every employer on the ATS. The apply URL https://candidate.webcruiter.com/cv?advertid=<id> 302s to /nb-no/Account/spalogin?ReturnUrl=%2Fcv%3Fadvertid%3D<id>; there is no guest path. Since 2026-09-03 the account is handled by fill.mjs via ensureAccount() (stored password in site_credentials, key = bare host). After login the application is a SEQUENTIAL accordion (Knockout + Kendo) at /nb-no/cv?advertid=<id>#personalapply: a draft application (own Webcruiter-ID, listed under 'Påbegynte' on /nb-no/Home) is created server-side as soon as the page opens — that is a draft, not a submission. Each section must be saved with its own 'Lagre' before the next one unlocks (later headings carry aria-disabled=true). Personalia opens in edit mode on EVERY load, prefilled from the profile, but 'Gyldig arbeidstillatelse for Norge' is never prefilled and is required (PUT /api/personaldetail/<id> → 422 'WorkingPermit må fylles ut'). Every screening question is required (PUT save_question → 422 'Spørsmålet "…" mangler et svar'). 'Send søknad' is disabled until Personalia + Spørsmål + Søknadstekst are saved. Two-factor login (one-time code by e-mail, #Login_Code) is OFF on the account — do not enable it. No CAPTCHA anywhere. Superseded: the 2026-07-27 manual_review verdict.

urlShape.note: advertid is the stable per-posting id; link_source_id / utm_* are tracking noise and can be dropped. The advert itself lives on a tenant host (<tenantId>.webcruiter.no/Main2/Recruit/Public/<advertid>) whose 'Søk på stillingen' button links to the candidate URL.

accountFlow.detect: goto loginUrl; if the URL no longer contains spalogin → 'guest' (session valid). Fill #Start_Email, click #start-next-button, read POST /api/account/validateemail: 200 → 'wall' (profile exists), 404 → 'login' (no profile → register). CAPTCHA iframe → 'captcha' (never seen).
accountFlow.login: on the login view fill #Login_Password_show, click #login-next-button; success = URL leaves /Account/spalogin (lands on the ReturnUrl). Rejection text in #login-form .validation-summary-errors. If #Login_Code appears (2FA on) the script reads the mailed code over IMAP and submits #verifycode-next-button — untested, 2FA is off.
accountFlow.requestReset: on the login view click a[href="#forgot-view"], fill #RecoveryByEmail_Email, click #forgot-next-button ('Send nytt passord').
accountFlow.completeReset: open the link, fill #Password_show, click a#reset-button ('Lagre nytt passord') → lands logged-in on /nb-no/Home. Verified 2026-09-03.
accountFlow.register: after validateemail 404 the register view shows: #Register_FullName, #Register_MobilePhone_CountryCode, #Register_MobilePhone, #Register_Password_show, terms checkbox form#register-form input[type=checkbox], #register-next-button. Expected next: one-time code view (#Login_Code + #verifycode-next-button) → 'verify-code'. Untested end-to-end (the applicant already had a profile).

hooksTested.requestReset: 2026-09-03 (link received, reset completed on the legacy bmw account)

registerGotchas: Unknown e-mail + ReturnUrl → «new profile + application» view (#appl) without a password step; register on the BARE spalogin page instead (e-mail → #start-continue-button → #register-view).
Phone mask is knockout-bound: fill() leaves Register.MobilePhone.Number empty → 422 «Mobilnummer må fylles ut»; type with keyboard.type.
«Bekrefte e-post» mail from noreply@webcruiter.com carries a /Account/ConfirmEmail link; opening it confirms («E-posten din er nå bekreftet»).

sectionMechanics.heading: h2.element-header:has-text('<name>') → ancestor div.panel-heading (Knockout click binding); the panel is ancestor div.we-panel, expanded state = class we-panel-expanded; locked = panel-heading[aria-disabled=true]
sectionMechanics.summaryMode: a saved section shows a preview with an 'Endre' button — click button:visible:has-text('Endre') inside the panel to re-enter edit mode (a hidden .btn-block mobile twin exists, always filter :visible)
sectionMechanics.editLock: while ANY section is in edit mode the other sections do not open (rightPanelDisabled) — save the current one first

fields.label: dynamic per-advert screening questions
fields.selector: div.we-panel:has(h2.element-header:has-text('Spørsmål')) .mb-xl:visible — question text in span.h5; options as label.k-radio-label:visible (input.k-radio, name = questionId, id = answerId); free text as textarea.free-text:visible (id = questionId)
fields.gotcha: EVERY question is required (422 'mangler et svar'). Match answers by label substring; for radios the answer must equal one option text (case-insensitive, e.g. 'JA'/'Nei'). Hidden radios exist behind free-text questions — always filter :visible. Test advert had 8 questions: 3 Ja/Nei + 5 free text (HPR number, motivation, relevant experience, personal qualities, worked in Sykehjemsetaten).

fields.label: Søknadstekst*
fields.gotcha: a real <textarea> (verified tagName), placeholder 'Skriv søknaden din her', no maxlength attribute and no visible counter — the UI only advises 'mellom tre avsnitt og én A4-side'. Section is locked (aria-disabled) until Spørsmål is saved. 'Se tidligere søknader' offers to copy an old letter — ignore it.

fields.label: Innvandrerbakgrunn / Nedsatt funksjonsevne / Fortrinnsrett / Unntatt offentlighet

fields.label: Arbeidserfaring* / Utdanning* / Språkkunnskaper
fields.selector: (structured master CV, 'Legg til på CV' dropdown)
fields.gotcha: the profile's structured CV satisfies 'CV *' — nothing to upload on the test advert. The script only verifies that Arbeidserfaring entries exist.

fields.label: Legg til CV (CV som vedlegg til søknaden)
fields.gotcha: Kendo upload widget shown only when the advert asks for a CV attachment (model.ShowUploadCV); accept .doc .docx .pdf .txt .rtf .odt .html, max 5 MB. When visible the script uploads cvPath there. Attached file list: #attachment-list-view-jobapplication.

fields.label: Opprett CV automatisk

fields.label: Ny referanse

fields.label: Legg til vedlegg

fields.label: Forhåndsvisning av søknaden
fields.gotcha: safe preview modal

fields.label: Slette søknaden

submitButton.name: Send søknad
submitButton.gotcha: disabled (data-bind disabled:bottomShouldGray) until Personalia+Spørsmål+Søknadstekst are saved; after it becomes enabled nothing else stops a click — fill.mjs clicks it only with submit:true, empty required_missing/unmapped and FILL_DRY_RUN!=='1'. Post-submit view shows 'Takk for søknaden' (template text); a confirmation modal may exist — the submit branch is UNTESTED as of 2026-09-03 (the test advert is a real nursing job that must not be applied to).
